items.title: See what's new
items.text: Read what changed with each update, right here in the Feedback menu.

items.title: Feedback on one page
items.text: Send us ideas and vote on ideas from other teams – all in the Feedback menu.

image.name: r13-feedback
image.alt: The Feedback menu: a box to write to us, below it a list of ideas with votes

items.title: Anonymous voting
items.text: Hide the names on revealed cards for everyone. Nobody can tell who played which card. Emojis still work.
items.where: Board settings → Results → Names on revealed cards → Anonymous

items.title: Join with an AI assistant (beta)
items.text: Add Agile Poker to Claude or ChatGPT and give it the invite link. It joins under the name you choose, plays the card you name and tells you what happens. Your assistant sees the board like you do. This is a beta – we would love to hear how it works for you: just send us feedback.

image.name: r10-ai
image.alt: The window "Play via your AI assistant" with the link to copy and three short steps

items.title: See who plays through an AI
items.text: A small robot next to a name shows who plays through an AI assistant. If your team does not want this, switch AI assistants off for the whole board.
items.where: Board settings → Team → Allow AI assistants → Off

items.title: Open API: connect Jira and other tools
items.text: Agile Poker now has a public, documented API. Use it to bring items from Jira (for example with Jira Automation) or from your own tools straight into your list of items to estimate. Create a key for it here and keep it secret like a password; the "API docs" link next to it shows how it works.

image.name: r9-apikeys
image.alt: The section "API keys" in the You menu with a field for the name of the key and the button "Create key"

items.title: Your settings in one place
items.text: Name, role and colour mode are now in one place. "Delete my data" removes your name, settings, votes, feedback and keys from all your boards. This cannot be undone.

items.title: Taken off the table? Join again in one click
items.text: If a teammate takes you off the table, for example because you were away, you can join again as a player or keep watching as an observer.
items.where: the message you see when this happens

items.title: Opens faster
items.text: The board appears sooner when you open it, especially on a slow connection.

items.title: Each emoji once a day
items.text: To keep things calm, everyone can throw each emoji once a day. The emoji bar shows which ones you can still throw today.
items.where: click or tap a card on the table

items.title: A list of items to estimate
items.text: Put your backlog items in a list and estimate them one after the other, without typing a new topic each time.

image.name: r4-items
image.alt: The Topic menu with the tab Items: a list of four items, the first one is being estimated

items.title: Look back at your estimates
items.text: Finished items keep their result and how the team voted, and you can copy the results or download them as a file for Excel.

image.name: r4-done
image.alt: The Topic menu with the tab Done: two finished items with their agreed values, and the buttons Copy and Download CSV

items.title: The median
items.text: After the reveal, a dashed line in the result chart marks the median – helpful when one card is far off.
items.where: Board settings → Results → Average and median → Show

items.title: Hear a nudge
items.text: A nudge is a friendly reminder for someone who has not picked a card yet. Now you hear a soft sound, even in another tab. It is on unless you switch it off.
items.where: You → Play a sound when someone nudges you

items.title: Fold the sidebar away
items.text: On a computer you can fold the sidebar into a narrow strip or drag it wider, and the board remembers your choice.
items.where: the arrows at the top of the sidebar

items.title: Cards with a title and a description
items.text: Card sets such as "Delegation Poker" and "Consent decision" show a title and a short explanation on every card, so everyone knows what it means.

image.name: r3-rich
image.alt: Delegation Poker cards on the table, each with a number, a title like "Consult" and a short explanation

items.title: Create your own card sets
items.text: Make a card set with your own values, colours and texts. It belongs to your team's board: everyone there can use and change it.
items.where: Board settings → Deck → Change → New set

image.name: r3-own
image.alt: The editor for your own card set: the set name, the list of cards, and the card M with the title "Medium", a short description and a colour

items.title: Throw emojis and nudge
items.text: Click or tap a card on the table to throw an emoji at it, or to nudge someone who has not picked a card yet.
items.where: click or tap a card on the table

items.title: See who is there
items.text: Observers are listed below the cards, and a player's card shows when that person is away or has lost the connection.

items.title: Play cards with the keyboard
items.text: On a computer, press the letter shown below a card (Q, W, E …) to play it without the mouse.

items.title: The result at a glance
items.text: After the reveal, a bar chart in the sidebar shows how many people chose each card, so differences stand out at once.
items.where: the sidebar on the right (phones: above your cards)

image.name: r2-result
image.alt: The result in the sidebar: a bar for each card value with the number of votes, a marker for the average and a line for the median

items.title: Countdown timer
items.text: Set a time limit, for example 5 or 10 minutes, and everyone sees the same countdown.
items.where: Timer → On → Mode: Timer (not Stopwatch), then pick the minutes

image.name: r2-countdown
image.alt: The countdown at the bottom right with 4 minutes 51 seconds left, above the buttons for a new round and the next item

items.title: Timer starts with each round
items.text: The timer can start again by itself with every new round.

items.title: Swipe through your cards
items.text: On phones and tablets, swipe through your cards and tap the one in the middle to play it.

items.title: A fresh new look
items.text: A calmer board with clear places for the topic, the table and your cards, in light and in dark mode.

image.name: r1-board
image.alt: The whole board: the menu at the top, the table with cards, the sidebar and your cards at the bottom

items.title: Works on phones and tablets
items.text: The board fits every screen, menus open from the bottom on a phone, and all buttons are big enough for your thumb.
items.where: open the board link on your phone

image.name: r1-phone
image.alt: The board on a phone: the table with cards, and your cards to swipe through at the bottom

items.title: Send us feedback
items.text: Report a problem or suggest an idea right from the board, and vote on what others have asked for.
